items.exampleEn: Prices rose sharply after the holiday.
items.exampleZh: 假期過後物價急遽上漲。

items.exampleEn: She wore an elegant black dress to the dinner.
items.exampleZh: 她穿了一件優雅的黑色洋裝去參加晚宴。

items.exampleEn: Our new manager is young and dynamic.
items.exampleZh: 我們的新經理年輕又有活力。

items.exampleEn: Please read the contract thoroughly before you sign it.
items.exampleZh: 簽約前請把合約仔細讀過一遍。

items.exampleEn: This job offers a lot of flexibility in working hours.
items.exampleZh: 這份工作的上班時間很有彈性。

items.exampleEn: The preliminary results of the test look good.
items.exampleZh: 測試的初步結果看起來不錯。

items.exampleEn: His informal way of speaking makes customers feel relaxed.
items.exampleZh: 他說話的方式很隨和，讓顧客覺得很放鬆。

items.exampleEn: Our teacher strictly forbids phones during class.
items.exampleZh: 我們老師嚴格禁止上課時用手機。

items.sentenceEn: Our team checked every number thoroughly, so the report has no mistakes.
items.sentenceZh: 我們團隊把每個數字都徹底檢查過，所以報告沒有任何錯誤。

items.audioEn: Lunch with the new manager will be informal, so you don't need to prepare a speech.
items.audioZh: 和新經理的午餐會很輕鬆，所以你不用準備致詞。
items.questionZh: 說話者說你不需要做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The hotel lobby is simple but elegant.
items.sentenceZh: 飯店大廳簡單卻很高雅。

items.sentenceEn: Our team needs more flexibility to respond to customers quickly.
items.sentenceZh: 我們團隊需要更多彈性，才能快速回應顧客。

items.stemEn: These are only ____ numbers; the final report will come out next month.
items.stemZh: 這些只是初步的數字；最終報告下個月才會出來。

items.stemEn: The rules are ____ followed here; nobody may enter without a badge.
items.stemZh: 這裡嚴格遵守規定；沒有識別證的人一律不得進入。

items.passageEn: When I joined my new company, I was surprised by how informal it was. People wore jeans, and meetings felt like friendly chats. But the work itself was strictly organized. Every project began with a preliminary meeting, and every report was checked thoroughly before it went to a client. My manager, a dynamic woman named Rachel, explained that the company gives staff flexibility in how they work, but not in the quality of their results. When sales dropped sharply last year, she did not panic; she simply asked the team for ideas. Her office is small but elegant, with one painting and lots of plants.
items.passageZh: 我剛進新公司時，很驚訝它的氣氛這麼輕鬆。大家穿牛仔褲上班，開會就像朋友聊天。但工作本身組織得非常嚴謹。每個專案都從一場初步會議開始，每份報告送給客戶前都會徹底檢查。我的經理 Rachel 是一位很有活力的女性，她解釋說，公司讓員工在工作方式上有彈性，但在成果品質上沒有彈性。去年銷售急遽下滑時，她沒有慌張，只是請團隊提供想法。她的辦公室不大但很高雅，只有一幅畫和許多盆栽。

questions.questionZh: 作者剛進公司時對什麼感到驚訝？
options: 新進員工的薪水非常高

questions.questionZh: 去年銷售急遽下滑時，Rachel 怎麼做？

items.promptZh: 這裡的規定執行得很嚴格。
referenceEn: The rules here are strictly enforced.
People here follow the rules strictly.
rubricZh: strictly 修飾動詞（例如 are strictly enforced、we strictly follow the rules）
「規定」可寫 rules、regulations 等；「執行」可寫 enforced、followed 等

items.instructionZh: 用 elegant 造一個句子，描述你覺得很優雅的人、衣服或地方。
referenceEn: My grandmother always looks elegant, even at home.
I had dinner at an elegant restaurant by the river last week.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 elegant，當形容詞（例如 an elegant restaurant、looks elegant）
描述的對象要合理（人、衣著、地方、設計等）
